$schema_note: agent-ui estate doctrine manifest (seeded 2026-08-19; doctrine-audit was SKIP-no-manifest every run before this). Separate from any naming manifest. Enumerates canon-to-dependent DOCTRINE edges: a rule stated canonically in one artifact that a dependent artifact must not violate, omit, or paraphrase away from. Edge types per authorkit:doctrine-audit sweep.py: verbatim-line (mode require|forbid), ledger-sync, vocab-term, judgment. Starter set of 6 edges, each verified live against the files on disk at seed time — canon rules that have actually bitten (GH #754's copied-event-list drift; ADR-0163's stale carve-out) or are load-bearing (the import DAG, the sizing law).
